title: Sarah's Death and Burial

questions.question: How old was Sarah when she died?
What did Abraham purchase from Ephron?
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:17-18: Abraham purchased the field and cave.

questions.question: Where was Sarah buried?
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:19: Sarah was buried in the cave of Machpelah.

questions.question: Did Abraham own the burial land?
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:20: The field and cave were made over to Abraham as property.

questions.question: Who did Abraham negotiate with for the burial site?
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:10-16: Abraham negotiated with Ephron the Hittite.

questions.question: How much silver did Abraham pay for the field?
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:15-16: Abraham paid 400 shekels of silver.

questions.question: What did Abraham call himself when speaking to the Hittites?
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:4: "I am a sojourner and foreigner among you."

questions.question: Did Ephron initially offer to give the field for free?
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:11: Ephron offered to give Abraham the field.

questions.question: What nationality were the people Abraham negotiated with?
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:10: Ephron was among the Hittites.

questions.question: What was the other name for Hebron?
Where was the negotiation conducted?
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:10: The transaction occurred at the gate in the hearing of all who entered.

questions.question: What trees were in the field?
options: All the trees in the field
questions.correctAnswer: All the trees in the field
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:17: All the trees in the field were included in the sale.

questions.question: What standard were the weights measured by?
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:16: "according to the weights current among the merchants."

questions.question: What was confirmed as Abraham's possession?
options: The field, cave, and all trees
questions.correctAnswer: The field, cave, and all trees
questions.explanation: Genesis 23:17-18: The field, cave, and all trees were made over to Abraham.

key_verse_text: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah east of Mamre (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
